1.title: The Digital Transition in Construction
1.description:
Construction is often associated with the image of a conservative sector that is not very digital. Even so, recent data shows that this sector is one of the most resilient and promising. Despite the pandemic crisis, it recorded growth of 2.5% in gross production value in 2020.

However, given the current situation, this reality could change. Digitalisation is therefore essential.

In this first episode of TechOnBUILT we talk about the Digital Transition in the AEC sector. Where are we and where are we going? What challenges lie ahead? To help us answer these questions we are joined by Rita Moura, Chair of the PTPC and the AEC Cluster, with Paulo Fonseca, Executive Director of BUILT CoLAB, as moderator.

2.title: BIM, much more than a buzzword.
2.description:
Building Information Modelling is an advanced way of working that helps architects, engineers and construction professionals in the planning, design, construction and management of infrastructure development and construction. This way of working integrates the five main aspects of a project to ensure maximum effectiveness throughout the whole process: Information, Technology, People, Processes and Policies. Contrary to what some people think, BIM is not an application or software for producing 3D models of infrastructure, but rather a methodology for working with 3D, 4D, 5D and even 6D models: time, costs, operations and other factors. Whether or not to use BIM will very quickly stop being an option and become a necessity.

In this second episode we were joined by Miguel Pires, Technical Director of Grupo Casais, who talked to us about the use of BIM methodologies, in a conversation led by António Aguiar Costa, Research and Development Director of BUILT CoLAB.

You can also listen to this Podcast on Apple and PodBean.

3.title: Horizon Europe - A Path to Innovation in the AEC Sector
3.description:
Horizon Europe is the European Commission's new research and innovation framework programme. The AEC Sector has an opportunity here to invest in innovation with a very attractive funding instrument and the possibility of partnering with the best that is being done across Europe and even worldwide. An opportunity not to be missed!

In this third episode we were joined by Luís Maia, ANI National Contact Point for Horizon Europe for Cluster 5 “Climate, Energy and Mobility”, who explains how this funding opportunity can help our companies find the path to innovation.

You can also listen to this Podcast on Spotify, Apple and PodBean.

4.title: Modular Construction, Sustainability and Digitalisation
4.description:
If modular and prefabricated construction was once seen as a lower-quality type of construction, it is now emerging as a modern, more industrialised form of construction with high performance, while also being aesthetically interesting, highly functional and sustainable.

In this fourth episode we talk to Luís Rocha, CEO of Portilame, a Portuguese company that focuses on timber construction and invests in digital technology and specialised human resources to design and build to high quality standards. With him we discuss the challenge of Modular Construction in the context of sustainability and digitalisation, particularly in terms of energy performance and environmental impact, and how these are enhanced by digital technologies such as BIM and digital fabrication.

You can also listen to this Podcast on Spotify, Apple and PodBean.

5.title: Aligning the AEC sector's strategy with RIS3
5.description:
The northern region of Portugal is home to 3.6 million inhabitants, almost 35% of the population residing in Portugal, accounts for nearly 39% of national exports and represents around 29% of the national economy's GDP. It is in this context that we consider it important to reflect on the AEC sector's contribution to the region and its companies.

To this end, in this fifth episode we talk to António Cunha, Chair of CCDR-N, the North Regional Coordination and Development Commission, who gives us his view and that of the institution he leads on how the AEC sector can contribute to achieving the strategic objectives defined for the region for the 2021 to 2027 period, whose main pillars focus on digitalisation and the climate transition.

You can also listen to this Podcast on Spotify, Apple and PodBean.

6.title: The Digital Architecture Studio
6.description:
Digitalisation in architecture is much more than the use of software; it is also a way of making projects more tangible for clients, or increasing the efficiency of their application on site.

To tell us about developments in the field and trends for the future, we invited André Caiado, founding architect of Contacto Atlântico, onto this Podcast to give us his perspective on the use of digital solutions such as virtual and augmented reality, 3D printing, and the practical application of modular design in architecture. He also tells us how all these aspects contribute to reducing costs and improving the relationship with the client.

The conversation is led by João Moutinho, Business & Internationalisation Director of BUILT CoLAB.

You can also listen to this Podcast on Spotify, Apple and PodBean.

7.title: Artificial Intelligence in Construction
7.description:
The AEC sector often uses the buzzword Artificial Intelligence, but very few construction companies know what it is or what can be done with it.

In this seventh episode of the podcast we try to clarify what Artificial Intelligence is and how companies can use it to digitalise Processes, Products or Asset Management.

To do this, we are joined by Professor Alípio Jorge, Professor at the Faculty of Science of the University of Porto and coordinator of the centre for Artificial Intelligence and decision support at INESC TEC, who has many years of experience researching the practical application of Artificial Intelligence and was coordinator of the “National Artificial Intelligence Strategy”. The conversation is led by António Aguiar Costa of BUILT CoLAB.

You can also listen to this Podcast on Spotify, Apple and PodBean.

8.title: Gender Equality in Construction
8.description:
The AEC sector, which traditionally employs more men than women, is becoming increasingly equitable, with more and more women joining companies. However, this trend is more visible in positions usually held in the office and less so on site.

To give us their views on the topic, we invited three women who work in the sector onto this Podcast, each with different backgrounds and experiences: Rita Moura, Chair of BUILT CoLAB and engineer at Teixeira Duarte, Cláudia Antunes, architect, Consultant at StratBIM® and Regional Lead for Portugal at Women in BIM, and Cláudia Fernandes, BIM Architect at the Technical Department of Grupo Casais.

Together, they discuss on this episode of TechOnBUILT the presence and role of women in the world of Construction, their perceptions of how the topic has evolved in recent years, and the main positive and negative aspects. In doing so, they share their experiences, contributing to the discussion of a topic that is always present in the sector.

You can also listen to this Podcast on Spotify, Apple and PodBean.

9.title: Additive Manufacturing
9.description:
Additive Manufacturing is currently seen as a new way of building through 3D printing, and is therefore viewed as a solution for greater automation in the construction sector.

To better understand what it is and the advantages of 3D printing in Construction, in this episode of TechOnBUILT we talk to Florindo Gaspar, Professor at the Instituto Politécnico de Leiria and Researcher at CDRSP. With him we discuss this paradigm shift and how Additive Manufacturing can be one of the determining factors in the robotisation of construction, with very high competitive advantages: whether through its diverse potential uses – from creating prototypes or modules, to “printing” entire buildings or their parts in a factory environment or even on site – or by facilitating the industrialisation of construction and reducing waste production and consequent wastage.

João Moutinho, of BUILT CoLAB, leads this conversation.

You can also listen to this Podcast on Spotify, Apple and PodBean.

10.title: The new General Waste Management Regime
10.description:
In this tenth episode we discuss the topic of the nRGGR, the new General Waste Management Regime. To do this, we are joined by Teresa Baptista from the Quality, Environment, Health and Safety Department of Grupo ACA.

With her, we will specifically look at the management of uncontaminated soil and rock, LER code 17 05 04. Starting from a practical case and the action plan defined by Grupo ACA for managing this type of material, we will try to identify the main barriers to its implementation, the operational difficulties and the issue of By-product Declarations in the case of works of this scale, as well as the involvement of Municipal Councils in licensing works to receive this type of material. Finally, we will try to discuss how to streamline and promote the adoption of this new regulation for managing this type of material.

Paulo Fonseca, of BUILT CoLAB, leads this conversation.

You can also listen to this Podcast on Spotify, Apple and PodBean.

11.title: The Competence Centre as the Future of Rail in Portugal
11.description:
In this eleventh episode we talk about Rail in Portugal.

To do this, we talk to Paulo Duarte, Executive Director of the Portuguese Rail Platform, with whom we will find out how the implementation of the Ferrovia 2020 Plan is progressing and how the implementation of the Rail Competence Centre is going.

This Centre aims to be one of the pillars for the future of Rail in Portugal, training human resources and giving them the skills needed to carry out the “Comboio Português” project, which aims to boost the development of public and private industrial, technological and business capabilities in the rail sector.

Paulo Fonseca, of BUILT CoLAB, leads this conversation.

You can also listen to this Podcast on Spotify, Apple and PodBean.

12.title: The challenges of Construction Industrialisation and the Twin Transition
12.description:
In this 12th episode of TechOnBUILT, the last of 2021, we reflect on the challenges and opportunities of construction industrialisation and try to understand the importance the Twin Transition represents for sustainability, in other words, how digitalisation is driving progress towards more sustainable construction.

To talk to us about these topics we invited Hugo Santos Ferreira – Chair of the Portuguese Association of Real Estate Developers and Investors.

António Aguiar Costa, of BUILT CoLAB, leads this conversation.

You can also listen to this Podcast on Spotify, Apple and PodBean.

13.title: Review of the First Year of Innovation in the AEC Sector
13.description:
In this 13th episode, the last of this first series of the TechOnBUILT podcast, which began exactly 1 year ago, we take stock of the topics covered and the progress of BUILT CoLAB in its first year of activity!

Over the last 12 months of TechOnBUILT we talked to various guests about a range of topics relevant to the future of the AEC sector, from the importance of BIM to Artificial Intelligence, Modular Construction and 3D Printing. Important topics to discuss regarding the Innovation the sector will need to implement in the coming years.

To take stock of these conversations and also of BUILT CoLAB's first year of activity, its growth, its work and the objectives it has been achieving, we are joined by Luís Gomes, Vice-Chair of BUILT CoLAB and Director of Engineering and Innovation Services at Mota-Engil.

Paulo Fonseca leads this conversation.

You can also listen to this Podcast on Spotify, Apple and PodBean.
